item.title: Shukra Medtech, Laurus Labs among 4 healthcare stocks to hit 52-week highs and rally up to 26% in a month
item.description: The Sensex surged 905 points to close at 74,151, while four healthcare stocks hit fresh 52-week highs. Shukra Medtech, Acutaas Chemicals, Piramal Pharma and Laurus Labs recorded monthly gains of 12% to 26%.

item.title: Market wrap: Adani Ports SEZ, Adani Ent, Trent, Maruti Suzuki top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
item.description: Indian equities rallied on Thursday, with the Sensex rising 905 points and the Nifty gaining 238 points as easing crude oil prices, the US Federal Reserve’s rate decision and institutional buying lifted sentiment. Adani Ports SEZ and Adani Enterprises led Nifty gainers, while Trent and Maruti Suzuki were among the top losers.

item.title: Godrej Consumer Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 523 crore, revenue jumps 19%; co declares Rs 5/share dividend
item.description: Godrej Consumer Products posted 13.8% profit growth to ₹522.92 crore and 19% revenue growth to ₹4,413.09 crore in Q2 FY27. Strong international performance, expanding home care brands and a ₹5 interim dividend supported its outlook for sustained growth.

item.title: Suzlon Energy Q2 Results: Profit plunges 69% YoY to Rs 394 crore due to one-time deferred tax
item.description: Suzlon Energy reported a 69% year-on-year profit decline to ₹394 crore in Q2 FY27, despite 26% revenue growth to ₹4,869 crore. Record turbine deliveries, a 6,009 MW order book and a ₹2,048 crore net cash position strengthened its outlook.

item.title: ESAF Small Finance Bank posts Rs 160 crore Q2 profit as asset quality improves
item.description: ESAF Small Finance Bank reported a net profit of Rs 160 crore in Q2, reversing a Rs 116 crore loss in the year-ago period. Improved margins, lower provisions and stronger asset quality supported the turnaround, while advances and deposits grew 25% and 24%, respectively.

item.title: Trent Q2 Results: Cons profit jumps 25% YoY to Rs 468 crore; revenue climbs 22%
item.description: Trent Q2 Results: Trent reported a 25.3% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 468 crore, while revenue grew 21.9% to Rs 5,873 crore. EBITDA rose 29.6% to Rs 1,054 crore, with margins improving to 18.2%. The retailer expanded its footprint across Westside, Zudio and other lifestyle concepts.

item.title: 10 defence stocks rally up to 500% in FY27 so far; 5 turn multibaggers
item.description: India’s defence stocks have outperformed the Nifty 50 in FY27, with the sector index rising 22%. The top 10 performers gained 43–513%, including five multibagger stocks.

item.title: IndiGo Q2 Results: Loss narrows YoY to Rs 1,879 crore; revenue rises 26%
item.description: IndiGo Q2 Results: Budget airline IndiGo reported narrowing of its consolidated loss to Rs 1,879 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 2,582 crore in the year-ago quarter. However, the loss widened from Rs 237 crore posted in the preceding June quarter.

item.title: Tata Power, JSW Energy, Torrent Power: Ambit sees buying opportunity in power stocks after valuation reset
item.description: Ambit Capital sees the recent correction in power stocks as a re-entry opportunity, favouring Tata Power, JSW Energy and Torrent Power. Rising electricity demand, fresh capacity contracting and limited PPA visibility could drive the sector’s next growth phase.

item.title: Bajaj Electricals exec chairman Shekhar Bajaj to become non-executive board member from January
item.description: Bajaj Electricals executive chairman Shekhar Bajaj will step down from his current role by the end of 2026 after leading the company for four decades. He will transition to a non-executive board position from January 1, 2027, subject to shareholder approval. The move is part of the company’s shift towards a professionally managed, board-led governance model, it said.

item.title: RIL Q2 Results Preview: Profit outlook brightens as O2C business set to drive growth
item.description: Reliance Industries is expected to report 15-17% year-on-year growth in September-quarter EBITDA, driven by a sharp recovery in its oil-to-chemicals business. Brokerages expect stronger refining margins, higher throughput and a weaker rupee to offset subdued retail and oil and gas performance. Investors will track O2C profitability, Jio Platforms’ earnings and retail margins as RIL announces results.

item.title: Ambuja Cements Q2 Results: Net profit tanks 90% YoY to Rs 114 crore on tax reversal effect; revenue rises 10%
item.description: Ambuja Cements Q2 Results: The company reported a 90% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 114 crore due to a Rs 1,697 crore income tax provision reversal in the year-ago quarter. Revenue rose 10% to Rs 6,113 crore. Shareholders also approved the proposed amalgamation of ACC and Orient Cement with Ambuja, with completion expected in FY27, subject to approvals.

item.title: Pine Labs shares jump 7% as Q2 net profit soars 543% YoY to Rs 39 crore
item.description: Pine Labs shares rose sharply on Thursday after the fintech company reported a 543% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 38.6 crore. Revenue rose 24% to Rs 806.2 crore, while EBITDA increased 67.3%. Growth in payments, UPI transactions and international markets supported performance as the company expands into AI-led commerce.

item.title: Asian Paints Q2 Results: Net profit rises 7% YoY to Rs 1,068 crore; firm announces Rs 5.75/share dividend
item.description: Asian Paints Q2 Results: The paint maker reported a 7% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 1,068 crore, while revenue grew 17% to Rs 9,977 crore. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 5.75 per share, with November 4 set as the record date, even as shares fell 2%.

item.title: ACME Solar shares rally 5% after Q2 profit jumps over 100%, signs 400MV agreement with NTPC
item.description: ACME Solar shares rose 5% after its Q2 FY27 profit surged 133.5% to ₹269 crore and revenue climbed 67.5% to ₹1,007 crore. The rally was also supported by its subsidiary signing a 25-year power purchase agreement with NTPC for a 400 MW renewable energy project.

item.title: Jio Platforms is becoming more than a telecom company: Dolat Capital
item.description: Jio Platforms is poised to evolve beyond telecom as tariff hikes, 5G monetisation, home broadband and enterprise digital services drive its next growth phase, according to Dolat Capital. The brokerage initiated coverage with an Accumulate rating and a target price of Rs 1,435, citing strong growth prospects and rising free cash flow.

item.title: Michael Burry says Anthropic IPO papers show AI industry is 'catastrophically vulnerable'. What the 'Big Short' investor sees
item.description: Investor Michael Burry warned that Anthropic’s planned IPO exposes serious vulnerabilities in the AI industry, citing massive infrastructure commitments, slowing growth and mounting costs. The investor, known for predicting the 2008 financial crisis, believes disappointing AI revenues could trigger a significant market correction and capital losses.

item.title: Jio Q2 Preview: First results after listing tomorrow. What should investors expect?
item.description: Jio Platforms will announce its first quarterly results as a listed company on October 30, with brokerages expecting double-digit revenue growth in Q2 FY27. Nomura projects revenue of Rs 40,400 crore and net profit of Rs 7,610 crore, while subscriber additions and ARPU growth will be key metrics for investors.

item.title: HUL shares rise 3% after Q2 results. Jefferies, Nomura cut target price but forecast 29% upside potential
item.description: Hindustan Unilever shares rose on Thursday after the FMCG major reported a 4% year-on-year increase in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 2,790 crore and 15% revenue growth to Rs 18,226 crore. Jefferies, Nomura and JM Financial cut their target prices but continue to see upside potential of up to 29%.

item.title: Technical picks for Diwali! 10 stocks PL Capital is bullish on this festive season. See full list
item.description: Brokerages see potential upside in 10 stocks, including DLF, Apollo Hospitals, GE Vernova T&D India and Jindal Steel, citing bullish chart patterns, improving momentum and signs of recovery. Technical indicators suggest further gains, though investors should assess risks and verify stop-loss levels.

item.title: Vedanta Aluminium more than doubles profit; cost cuts in focus to drive earnings
item.description: Vedanta Aluminium’s September-quarter net profit more than doubled, while revenue rose 41% and EBITDA surged 83% year-on-year. The company expects higher production volumes and lower costs to support earnings despite declining aluminium prices. Production costs could fall 6% by year-end, aided by increased captive bauxite availability and operational efficiencies.

item.title: Adani group stocks jump up to 3%, add Rs 23,000 crore to total m-cap. What’s behind the surge?
item.description: Adani Group stocks rose on Thursday, adding Rs 23,000 crore to their combined market capitalisation, as Q2 results and bullish brokerage calls lifted sentiment. Adani Power reported a 134% jump in net profit, while Jefferies raised its target price for Adani Ports and sees significant upside in Adani Enterprises.

item.title: Jefferies initiates coverage on NSE with ‘Buy’; here’s why it sees fresh growth potential
item.description: Jefferies has initiated coverage on NSE with a ‘Buy’ rating and a target price of Rs 2,085, indicating over 17% upside. The brokerage expects structural growth, market leadership, diversification and new businesses to drive a 15% revenue CAGR over FY27–29 and support margin expansion.

item.title: Vedanta Aluminium reports 41% revenue growth to Rs 22,066 crore in September quarter
item.description: In the September quarter, Vedanta Aluminium experienced a remarkable 41% growth in revenue year-on-year. Despite predictions of falling aluminium prices, production is on the rise due to enhanced capacity. The company forecasts a reduction in production costs by 6% by year's end. Operational enhancements indicate that earnings will still rise, positioning Vedanta positively amid shifting market conditions.

item.title: City Union Bank shares rally 7% after Q2 net profit grows 27% YoY to Rs 416 Crore
item.description: City Union Bank shares rose sharply on Thursday after the lender reported a 27% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 416 crore. Net interest income grew 31%, while asset quality improved, with gross NPAs falling to 1.44%. Deposits and advances also recorded strong growth during the quarter.

item.title: Why is market rallying today? Sensex jumps 900 points, Nifty above 22,900. 6 key factors behind Rs 5 lakh crore gains
item.description: The Indian stock market saw a vibrant uptick as both Sensex and Nifty surged over 1.1%, attributed to the Federal Reserve's decision to maintain interest rates. Renewed interest from foreign investors was evident, with net purchases of Indian equities totaling approximately Rs 872 crore on Wednesday. Optimism surrounding potential reductions in long-term capital gains tax also fostered positive market sentiment.

item.title: Sensex jumps over 500 points, Nifty above 22,850 after Fed keeps rates unchanged. What lies ahead?
item.description: Following the Federal Reserve's recent decision, the Indian stock market surged, with Sensex rising by over 500 points and Nifty up by more than 150 points. Adani Ports and Power Grid were among the top gainers, while Trent faced a downturn. The breadth of the market remained positive, as advances outnumbered declines on the NSE. Analysts, however, highlighted potential global economic issues that could pose challenges for India.

item.title: Jupiter Wagons shares rally 8% on Rs 1,140 crore Railway Board order
item.description: Jupiter Wagons shares rallied over 8% after securing a Rs 1,140 crore Railway Board order for 2,583 wagons. The company expects additional order inflows of around Rs 2,000 crore in Q4 FY27, supported by government and private-sector demand. Despite the gains, the stock has fallen 25% in three months and trades below seven of its eight simple moving averages.

item.title: CarTrade Tech shares tank over 6% after Q2 results, but Nomura raises target price to Rs 3,377. Here’s why
item.description: CarTrade Tech shares fell 6.5% after Q2FY27 net profit rose 3% year-on-year to Rs 66 crore, while revenue increased 10% to Rs 213 crore. Nomura raised its target price to Rs 3,377 from Rs 3,340, citing growth potential in OLX India, improving consumer business prospects and operating leverage, despite trimming revenue estimates by around 3%.

item.title: Hyundai Motor shares jump 6% even as Q2 net profit declines 24% YoY. Why Nomura, other brokerages remain bullish?
item.description: Hyundai Motor India shares rose despite a sharp decline in Q2 FY27 profit as rising commodity costs squeezed margins. Nomura and Motilal Oswal retained their Buy ratings, citing new model launches, export growth and potential margin recovery.

item.title: Potential LTCG tax cut could revive FIIs’ India bet, says Jefferies: Which stocks may benefit most?
item.description: Jefferies sees a potential long-term capital gains tax (LTCG) cut as a possible trigger for foreign investors to return to Indian equities after record outflows. Banks, Reliance Industries, utilities and real estate stocks could be the biggest beneficiaries. Here’s where foreign investors are positioned and what a tax cut could mean.

item.title: Nifty’s early comeback signal: Why largecaps are holding up as broader market slides
item.description: India’s equity market divergence suggests largecaps may be regaining leadership as mid- and smallcaps remain under pressure. The Nifty has recovered to broadly flat returns in October, while midcap and smallcap indices have declined. More reasonable valuations, earnings resilience, liquidity and institutional preference are supporting largecaps, though elevated crude prices, macroeconomic uncertainty and earnings concerns continue to cloud the broader market outlook.

item.title: Adani Ports shares rise 3% after Q2 results. Why did Jefferies and Nomura raise target prices?
item.description: Adani Ports shares rose after the company reported strong Q2 FY27 earnings and raised its full-year guidance. Jefferies and Nomura increased their target prices, citing robust international port performance, higher earnings estimates and long-term growth prospects.

item.title: Meesho shares fall 3% even as Q2 loss narrows to Rs 132 cr. Why Jefferies raised target price but Nomura remains cautious
item.description: Meesho shares fell nearly 3% after Q2 FY27 net loss narrowed 68% year-on-year to Rs 132 crore, while revenue rose 34% to Rs 4,132 crore. Brokerages remained divided, with Jefferies and Motilal Oswal maintaining Buy ratings and Nomura retaining Reduce, citing growth prospects, margins and festive-season demand.

item.title: Zee Entertainment among 4 stocks closing above VWAP
item.description: Four Nifty500 stocks featured in StockEdge’s VWAP scan on October 28, with closing prices more than 2% above their respective volume-weighted average prices, indicating positive price action during the session.

item.title: Jio Platforms shares jump 5% on Day 2 after ending 27% higher on debut day. Buy, sell or hold?
item.description: Jio Platforms shares rose further after a strong market debut, climbing over 32% above the IPO price. Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Elara Capital initiated coverage with Buy ratings, citing tariff hikes, ARPU growth and digital services opportunities.

item.title: Bajaj Auto Share Price Highlights: Bajaj Auto Stock Price History
Ambani magic captivates India once more with blockbuster deal
item.description: Jio Platforms Ltd. recorded India's largest IPO, raising $3.1 billion and experiencing a 27% rise in shares. The Ambani family strategically adapted the deal structure and lowered valuations to attract investors. Mukesh Ambani's son Akash played a significant role in this IPO process, marking a milestone for the Ambani dynasty. Jio's market valuation exceeded $130 billion, becoming India's second-most valuable company.

Securities Appellate Tribunal quashes Rs 1.49 crore penalty on Ventura Securities by MCX
item.description: In a pivotal decision, the Securities Appellate Tribunal annulled a ₹ 1.49 crore penalty that MCX had levied against Ventura Securities for purported client violations. The tribunal's ruling stemmed from the finding that the order was signed by an ex-member of the committee. As a result, the tribunal has ordered MCX to reimburse the fine, including an additional ₹ 1 lakh for the brokerage's legal expenses.

PVR Inox Q2 profit rises 111% to Rs 273 crore, targets 500 new screens in 3 years
item.description: PVR INOX plans an ambitious expansion, targeting to unveil around 90 to 100 new screens in FY 2027 and 150 to 175 in FY 2028. With a focus on Tier 2 to 4 markets, they'll introduce their innovative SMART Cinema format. Estimated capital expenditure for FY 27 is projected at ₹300-320 crore, adhering to a capital-light approach.

item.title: Pidilite Industries reports 7% YoY growth in net profit to Rs 626 crore
item.description: Pidilite Industries has achieved a remarkable 7% growth in consolidated net profit for the September quarter, with profits hitting ₹626 crore. This success is underpinned by a substantial increase in total revenue, soaring by over 21% to reach ₹4,285 crore. However, challenges such as tighter margins and rising input costs have tempered profit growth. Notably, the consumer segment saw a robust 20.
